# Serving South Florida for over 50 years

- ### Total Home Comfort





Since 1975, Lindstrom Air Conditioning & Plumbing has been South Florida's premier service provider, combining tradition with innovation to deliver exceptional cooling and plumbing solutions.

- ### Expect The Best





Our dedication to quality craftsmanship and 100% customer satisfaction has made us the trusted choice for thousands of homeowners who expect nothing but the best for their homes.

- ### Lifetime Parts & Labor Warranty





The true value of your investment goes beyond the immediate benefits—it’s about ensuring long-term protection and peace of mind with our industry-leading LIFETIME parts and labor warranty on select AC systems.
